interests:
- Big ideas from productivity classics, applied not just quoted: Deep Work, The One Thing, The Power of Habit, Do It Today, finishing what you start
- Money and wealth thinking: The Psychology of Money, The Millionaire Fastlane, The Richest Man in Babylon, Cashflow Quadrant, Felix Dennis's How to Get Rich
- Building and running a business: The E-Myth, Traction and EOS, Good to Great, 10x Is Easier Than 2x, Your Next Five Moves
- Mindset and self-mastery: Mindset (Dweck), Psycho-Cybernetics, The Courage to Be Disliked, Don't Believe Everything You Think, Breaking the Habit of Being Yourself
- Critical thinking and decision-making: Thinking Fast and Slow, Antifragile, The Black Swan, Think Again, The Road Less Stupid; mental models and cognitive biases explained with examples
- Human behaviour, influence and power: The Laws of Human Nature, The 48 Laws of Power, Influence (Cialdini), spotting narcissists and manipulation (Surrounded by Narcissists, The Sociopath Next Door)
- Stoic and practical philosophy: Marcus Aurelius, Seneca, Epictetus, Ryan Holiday; how the ideas hold up in daily life
- Discipline and mental toughness: Can't Hurt Me, Relentless, Extreme Ownership, The War of Art, The Obstacle Is the Way
- Communication and negotiation: Never Split the Difference, Crucial Conversations, How to Win Friends and Influence People, Nonviolent Communication, Talk Like TED
- Relationships and attachment: Attached, How to Be an Adult in Relationships, The 5 Love Languages, How to Not Die Alone
- Book summaries and "one idea in 30 seconds" posts, author interviews, reading lists, notes on how to read and remember more
- New books and papers in these areas, and the people writing seriously about them
- A book idea connected to building something real: AI agents and Claude Code, indie apps, a creator business, Instagram growth
- Score low: celebrity gossip, sports scores, crypto price talk, political outrage, motivation quotes with no source, engagement bait
- YouTube channel RSS, book-summary channels for the session to resolve to channel IDs from youtube.com: Productivity Game, FightMediocrity, The Swedish Investor, Escaping Ordinary, Four Minute Books, Ali Abdaal, Daily Stoic. Johan strikes any he does not want.
